name: benzyl alcohol + diphenhydramine + zinc oxide
purpose: Active ingredients Purpose Calamine 14.0 % (w/w) Skin protectant Benzyl Alcohol 10.5 % (w/w) External analgesic Diphenhydramine Hydrochloride 2.0 % (w/w) External analgesic
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with poison ivy, poison oak, poison sumac, insect bites or minor skin irritations. dries the oozing and weeping of poison: ivy oak sumac
otcwarn: Do not use on large areas of the body with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one taken by mouth Ask a doctor before use on chicken pox on measles Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
